resolutions.rationale: Nx 23.1.1 pins the vulnerable 5.0.8 patch; 5.0.9 is the registry-published security patch on the same API line.
resolutions.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned Nx/Lerna release accepts brace-expansion 5.0.9 or newer.

resolutions.rationale: Lerna 10.0.0 pins vulnerable js-yaml 4.3.0; 4.3.1 is the registry-published security patch on the same API line.
resolutions.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned Lerna release accepts js-yaml 4.3.1 or newer.

resolutions.rationale: Current Mocha 11 pins a vulnerable serializer range. Mocha uses this dependency only to serialize reporter metadata; the fixed registry major is covered by the complete backend test suite.
resolutions.removalCondition: Remove when a supported Mocha release accepts serialize-javascript 7.1.0 or newer, or when Mocha is replaced.
